description: verify_http_signature() in inbound.rs rebuilds the signed string using the 'headers' parameter from the Signature header itself. A sender can omit critical headers (e.g. '(request-target)' or 'date') from the headers= list and the server will verify a signature over a stripped signed string, allowing replay across different paths or stale requests. The server must enforce a minimum set of required headers regardless of what the sender advertises.
title: HTTP sig: signed-headers spec not cross-checked against sig header
